_about: Upgrade definitions (F22, TDD 'Upgrades & abilities'). type: passive = modifiers (always on) · active = an ability you equip, charge and fire · feature = a flag the screens read. byLevel[n-1] = the value AT level n (not added up). Passive effects: modifier = a name from src/engine/upgrades.ts Modifiers, op = 'mul' (multiply) or 'add'. Abilities: charge 0..1 (1 = ready), chargePerSecond while the shift is playing, chargePerSeal per crack sealed; byLevel = the effect's numbers. testOnly upgrades are for tests only: nothing in the game lists or grants them. The real 20 (design/upgrades-map.md) get added here when upgrades go into the game.
